card.name: Inside spelled-out study and drug-class names
card.fires_on: Partway through multi-part names or abbreviations where a lowering or reduction term comes next, such as trial titles, RAS inhibitors, or LDL-C-lowering. Also fires on a linking word inside a proper name.

modes.label: Trial titles
modes.description: Linking or inner words in the full name of a clinical study, just before a term like Cholesterol or Diabetes.
modes.example: Stroke Prevention by Aggressive Reduction<< in>> Cholesterol Levels (SPARCL)

modes.label: Abbreviation pieces
modes.description: The second piece of an abbreviation such as RAS or LDL-C, right before inhibitors or -lowering.
modes.example: Most patients receiving the combination of two R<<AS>> inhibitors do not obtain any additional benefit

modes.label: Other proper names
modes.description: The word the inside a railway or place name outside drug text.
modes.example: The coming of the Enfield branch of<< the>> Great Northern Railway changed the area completely.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long names and abbreviations, such as study titles and drug-class labels, before the name finishes.
